full_prompt_en: A square, heavily textured painting places a single dark-clothed figure near the lower-left side of a vast swirling blue seascape. The person stands facing right and slightly away from the viewer, wearing a knee-length dark coat, with the small head and straight body silhouetted against luminous water. The sea rises across most of the frame in overlapping arcs of turquoise, cobalt, teal, and deep violet. Near the center-left, a bright curl of pale aqua bends inward like a large wave or current, and smaller ridges repeat the movement toward the right. The foreground shore is built from broken blue and ocher strokes, flecked with tiny bright marks that suggest wetness or scattered reflected light. Above the water, the sky occupies the upper band. It is packed with countless small yellow, white, and blue points, with a warmer gold cloudlike glow near the upper center. The far horizon is difficult to separate because the water and sky share the same moving texture. Thick directional strokes and tiny dabs of paint are visible everywhere; smooth blending is almost absent. The most intense highlights sit on the wave curl and in the dense starry upper area, while the figure remains nearly black. The person is very small compared with the immense color field, giving the painting a strong sense of wonder and solitude. Curving flow lines pull the eye around the central water shape, while the compact vertical silhouette provides a still counterpoint. The composition is luminous, restless, and tactile, as though the entire air and sea are made of moving paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、厚重纹理的绘画把一名单独的深衣人物放在辽阔旋动蓝色海景的左下方。人物朝右并略背对观众，穿及膝深色外套，小小头部和笔直身体在发亮水面前成剪影。海水占据画面大部，由青绿、钴蓝、深青和深紫的重叠弧线升起。中央偏左，一道浅水蓝的明亮卷曲向内弯，像大浪或水流，较小的波脊向右重复这种运动。前景岸边由断续蓝色和赭色笔触构成，撒着细小亮点，暗示潮湿或零散反光。水面上方是一条天空。天空挤满无数黄、白、蓝色小点，上中央附近有一片更暖的金色云状光。远处地平线不易分开，因为水和天共享同样流动的质地。厚实的方向性笔痕和小块点彩处处可见，几乎没有平滑晕染。最强高光位于卷浪及密集星点的上部，而人物保持近黑。人在巨大的色域前极小，使绘画充满惊叹与孤独。弯曲流线把视线带着绕过中央水形，紧凑的竖向剪影则成为静止对位。构图发亮、躁动且可触，仿佛整个空气与海都由移动的颜料组成。
style_prompt_en: Thick impasto painting builds motion through overlapping curved strokes, short dabs, and thousands of small luminous flecks. Saturated turquoise, cobalt, teal, violet, and ocher gold interweave with almost no flat neutral area. Bright arcs spiral through a broad field, while a small dark vertical accent gives scale and stillness. Light appears embedded in the paint itself, concentrated in pale aqua curves and scattered warm points. Preserve raised tactile texture and visible directional marks throughout; allow the boundary between atmosphere and surface to soften. The effect is immersive, energetic, and solitary.
style_prompt_zh: 厚涂绘画以重叠弯笔、短点染和成千上万的小亮点构建运动。饱和青绿、钴蓝、深青、紫与赭金互相交织，几乎没有平坦的中性色区域。明亮弧线在宽阔场域中旋转，一个小小深色竖向重音提供尺度与静止。光仿佛嵌在颜料本身，集中于浅水蓝曲线与零散暖色点。处处保留凸起可触的纹理和可见方向笔痕，让空气与表面的边界柔化。效果沉浸、充满能量而孤独。
theme_en: A lone dark figure before a swirling turquoise sea and starry gold sky
theme_zh: 孤独暗色人物立于旋动青绿海面与星点金光天空前
name: Iris Scott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
